svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TFT harness pipeline
svg.desc: A fixed harness reads the game from pixels, tracks units and executes actions every tick. The model under test is asked as needed with state text plus a screenshot and returns a plan; the plan for the next round is written during the fight, so the next planning phase starts executing at once.
svg.text: asked at once if no plan is queued; again when it ends or on a change
